note: QIA Register: Questions / Informations / Answers that must be addressed before any decision can reasonably be made. Status: Open = unknown, Partial = some info verified, Answered = verified from official source (link required). See docs/questions.html.

questions.question: What is the current (Week 11) official injury status for every starter?
questions.information_needed: Fresh NFL.com + club injury reports for Week 11 (Wed/Thu/Fri practice + game status + inactives)
questions.why: Injuries move lines by multiple points; Nov 11 snapshot is Week 10 and stale (F-02).
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN for Week 11. Nov 11 Week-10 snapshot verified (see injuries page).

questions.question: Who is the confirmed starting QB for each team in Week 11?
questions.information_needed: Club depth-chart announcements + NFL.com news for Week 11
questions.why: QB is the highest-leverage input; backup lists conflict (F-03).
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL: Week-10 starters verified for AZ (Beck), CLE (Watson); MIN undecided (Cousins). Week 11 unknown.

questions.question: What are the market (sportsbook) lines for Week 11 — open and close?
questions.information_needed: Licensed odds feed with timestamps (spread, ML, total, props)
questions.why: Own lines are meaningless without market comparison; no edge can be claimed (F-05).
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no odds feed collected.

questions.question: What is the model's home-field advantage value?
questions.information_needed: Historical home/away scoring split from play-by-play (multiple seasons)
questions.why: HFA directly sets the fair spread; guessing it biases every line.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — not yet estimated from data. Calculator default is a placeholder, labelled as such.

questions.question: How should ties, pushes, and overtime be handled in grading?
questions.information_needed: Market settlement rules per bet type (spread push, total push, ML tie handling)
questions.why: Grading ambiguity corrupts ROI/CLV.
questions.current_answer: PARTIAL: Standard rules documented in lines.html (whole-number push = refund). Confirm per-book rules when feed is chosen.

questions.question: What sample size proves skill vs luck?
questions.information_needed: Pre-registered gates: n, ROI, CLV, log-loss/Brier, significance tests
questions.why: Without gates, lucky streaks look like skill.
questions.current_answer: FRAMEWORK SET (strategies.html gates G0-G7), not yet applied — no graded bets exist.

questions.question: What are the empirical correlations between parlay/prop legs?
questions.information_needed: Play-by-play joint-outcome data to estimate P(A and B) vs P(A)*P(B)
questions.why: Parlay pricing depends on correlation; theoretical categories are not measurements (F-07).
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — only qualitative categories documented. No coefficients claimed.

questions.question: What is the bankroll, risk budget, and staking rule?
questions.information_needed: Operator decision: bankroll size, per-bet cap, loss limits, Kelly fraction
questions.why: Staking determines ruin risk more than pick selection.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — S-12 proposes 1% cap + quarter-Kelly. Awaiting decision.

questions.question: Which data sources are licensed/allowed for odds + play-by-play?
questions.information_needed: Terms review for nflverse, odds vendors, NFL.com reuse
questions.why: Legal/ToS compliance; scraping may violate terms.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — S-01/S-02 pending decision.

questions.question: What weather is forecast for each Week 11 outdoor game?
questions.information_needed: Timestamped forecast (wind, temp, precip) per stadium at bet time
questions.why: Totals/passing props are weather-sensitive.
questions.current_answer: UNKNOWN — no weather data collected (S-07).

questions.question: What are snap counts / target shares / route participation for prop candidates?
